description: Purchase of Green Gram Harvest of the Interim Season of 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Green Grams have been cultivated on an area of approximately 16,500 hectares in the Yala Season and Interim Season of 2025 under the programme for increasing productivity and production of Green Gram cultivation during 2025 implemented on the guidance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation. ​​ A harvest of about 14,600 metric tons of Green Gram is expected through this programme and out of which about 12,000 metric tons are expected to directly reach the local market. Currently, Green Gram harvesting has begun in the Hambantota District, and it has been reported that middlemen are buying the harvest at a low price of Rs. 450/- per kilogram. Therefore, the National Food Promotion Board, on the instructions of the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, has initiated a programme to purchase Green Gram harvest from farmers enabling to grant a reasonable price to farmers for their production. The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to provide the necessary provisions for purchasing Green Gram harvest in a competitive manner with the private sector by expanding the aforesaid programme, was approved by the Cabinet.
